_readme: TITAN CONFIG — edit values here, click RELOAD CONFIG in UI. Changes take effect next cycle.

MIN_BET._description: Minimum bet size in USD. Raised from $0.50 — sub-$1 bets lose to friction.

MAX_BET_ABS._description: Hard cap on any single bet in USD.

MAX_BET_PCT._description: Max bet as fraction of current bankroll.

KELLY_FRACTION._description: Fraction of full Kelly (0.08 = 1/12th Kelly, very conservative).

TAKER_FEE_RATE._description: Polymarket removed taker fees. Set to 0.

MIN_TRADE_CASH._description: Min USD for public feed trades. Raised from $50 to filter noise.

MAX_TRADES_FETCH._description: Max public feed trades per cycle.

HOT_HOURS._description: Trades within this many hours are HOT.

WARM_HOURS._description: Trades older than HOT but newer than this are WARM.

HFT_POLL_LIMIT._description: Trades to fetch per HFT wallet per cycle.

HFT_MIN_TRADES_PER_HOUR._description: A wallet must average this many trades/hour to be classified HFT. Raised from 20 to 100 to avoid mis-classifying sports bots like swisstony (454 TPH but $483 avg bet = not micro-HFT).

HFT_MIRROR_DELAY_MAX_SECONDS._description: Only mirror HFT trades placed within this many seconds. Tightened from 90 — stale HFT signals are worthless.

HFT_MIN_CASH_PER_TRADE._description: Min USD per trade for HFT wallets. Raised from $3 to $10 to filter genuine micro-HFT bot noise.

ELITE_POLL_LIMIT._description: Trades to fetch per elite wallet per cycle.

ELITE_POLL_MIN_CASH._description: Min USD per trade when polling elite wallets.

ELITE_TRADE_MIN_FRACTION._description: Elite trade must be >= this fraction of their avg_bet. 0.05 = 5% (catches HF bots).

MAX_SIGNAL_AGE_H._description: Max age in hours for a signal to be tradeable. Tightened from 2h — stale signals lose edge.

MIN_SCORE._description: Min score to appear. Raised from 40 to 50 to cut noise.

STRONG_SCORE._description: Score threshold for STRONG tier. Was same as MIN_SCORE (meaningless). Now properly tiered.

ALERT_SCORE._description: Score threshold for ALERT tier (auto-traded). Raised from 55.

MIN_CONFLUENCE._description: Min verified whales buying same side.

MAX_DRIFT._description: Skip if current price > whale avg entry by this much. Tightened from 20% to 10% — large drift means edge is gone.

MIN_DRIFT._description: Skip if current price < whale avg entry by this much. Tightened from -25% to -15% — large dip means whale was wrong.

MAX_ENTRY_SLIPPAGE._description: Max slippage above elite entry. Tightened from 12% to 6% — if price moved 6%+ since whale bought, edge is eaten.

STALE_LOSER_AGE_H._description: If signal this old AND losing, skip.

STALE_LOSER_DRIFT._description: Drift threshold for stale loser check.

MIN_LIQUIDITY._description: Min USD liquidity. Raised from $200 — low liquidity means our bet moves the price.

MIN_VOLUME._description: Min USD volume. Raised from $300 — low volume means illiquid market.

MIN_HOURS_LEFT._description: Skip markets closing in fewer hours than this.

MIN_WIN_RATE_WATCH._description: Min win rate to be watchable.

MIN_WIN_RATE_VER._description: Min win rate to be verified.

MIN_RESOLVED_BETS._description: Min resolved bets to be scored.

MIN_PNL._description: Min lifetime PnL to be watchable.

WILSON_MIN_WATCH._description: Wilson lower bound min to be watchable.

WILSON_MIN_VER._description: Wilson lower bound min to be verified.

MIN_AVG_PROFIT_PER_TRADE._description: Min avg profit per trade USD.

MIN_AVG_BET_SIZE._description: Min avg bet size USD. Low to include HFT bots.

ELITE_MIN_PNL._description: Elite requires lifetime PnL >= this USD.

ELITE_MIN_PORT._description: Elite requires portfolio proxy >= this USD.

ELITE_MIN_RESOLVED._description: Elite requires at least this many resolved bets.

LARGE_TRADE._description: Single trade >= this USD is large. Raised from $300 — $300 is routine for many whales.

MASSIVE_TRADE._description: Single trade >= this USD is 'massive'. Raised from $3000.

MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS._description: Max simultaneous open positions. Reduced to 6 — with CONVICTION-only trading, fewer higher-quality bets.

MAX_POSITIONS_PER_EVENT._description: Max positions sharing the same eventSlug.

MAX_POSITIONS_PER_WHALE._description: Max open positions triggered by the same single elite whale. Prevents one wallet (e.g. elkmonkey) flooding all slots.

PROFIT_TARGET_PCT._description: Auto-sell when position is up this fraction.

WHALE_EXIT_SELL._description: Exit when original triggering whale sells.

STOP_LOSS_PCT._description: Stop-loss at -20%. Tightened from -40% — cut losses faster to preserve capital.

EXIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS._description: Cooldown after closing a position before re-entering same market.

DISCOVERY_INTERVAL_CYCLES._description: Run whale discovery every N cycles.

WALLET_TTL._description: Wallet cache TTL in seconds (10 min).

MARKET_TTL._description: Market data cache TTL in seconds.

ACTIVITY_LIMIT._description: Max activity records for win rate.

vip_wallets._description: Polled every single cycle regardless of elite status. v9: Removed hedge/market-maker bots.

seed_watchlist._description: Wallets added to watchlist on first boot. v9: Removed known hedge bots.
